selectedDirection: Profile35; human-controller acknowledgment separate from zero-duration system finalization; no live-save reinterpretation.

questions.question: Two-human readiness must distinguish missing acknowledgment from readiness lost after acknowledging. Demonstrate the actual shared authority/session cutoff behavior; an unready session alone does not show whether another ready session can advance for it. Do not claim network/cohort support from a single-session hold.

Accepting defeat can finalize while a capable supplied helper remains nearby if care was deliberately declined. Native copy must state the actual policy/choice; do not falsely say nobody can reach the patient. Confirm deliberately terminating preserves the save and exact reopen.

Define the new owner historical/bounded continuation semantics. Finalization may retain a last witness, but repeated encounters must not become a lifetime cap or lose identity/receipt/history authentication. Exercise repeated episodes or the relevant real cut if a bounded append owner is introduced.

When one human has acknowledged and another requests care, treatment resumes the unfinalized episode and clears old acknowledgments atomically. Old exact receipts must remain retrievable but cannot satisfy a later result. Test this contrast with actual resource and timing state.

scope: Questions based on published design, not proven defects. Integration and independent critic resolve them against the delivered implementation.
